newsitem.title: FRANCE: CGE's SFR sees two million subscribers.
newsitem.headline: CGE's SFR sees two million subscribers.

text.p: SFR, the mobile phone subsidiary of Compagnie Generale des Eaux, expects the number of subscribers to roughly double to two million in the next year, managing director Philippe Germond said on Tuesday.
Germond told a news conference the number of subscribers rose 130 percent last year to 930,000, and turnover had more than doubled to 5.2 billion francs from 2.5 billion in 1995.
"Results clearly improved in 1996 but the year will not show a profit," he said. "We expect to break even in the last months of 1997, and show a profit for 1998."

Cumulative investments in SFR totalled 12 billion francs, including 2.9 billion for 1996. Germond said investment this year would at least match last year's level and probably be "around three billion francs".
